name: atrium
description: Atrium is a self-hosted client portal for agencies and freelancers. Share project progress, files, and updates with your clients through a beautiful branded portal. Features: - Project management with status tracking - File sharing with S3/MinIO/R2 or local storage - Branded client portal - Email notifications via Resend - Multi-user with role-based access Database: Includes a built-in PostgreSQL database by default. To use an existing external database, set "Use Built-in DB" to false and provide your DATABASE_URL.

paths.name: Database Storage
paths.description: Path to store built-in PostgreSQL data (only used when built-in DB is enabled)

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Atrium web interface

variables.name: Auth Secret
variables.description: Random string (min 32 chars) for signing auth tokens. Generate at: https://generate-secret.vercel.app/32

variables.name: Use Built-in DB
variables.description: Use the built-in PostgreSQL. Set to false and provide DATABASE_URL to use an external database.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: External PostgreSQL connection string. Only needed if built-in DB is disabled. Example: postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/atrium

variables.name: Storage Provider
variables.description: Storage backend: local, s3, minio, or r2

variables.name: S3 Endpoint
variables.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL (for MinIO, R2, etc.)

variables.name: Resend API Key
variables.description: Resend API key for sending emails (optional)

variables.name: Max File Size (MB)
variables.description: Maximum file upload size in megabytes

variables.name: Skip DB Push
variables.description: Skip automatic database schema sync on startup (for pooled connections)
